summary: Classifies a UI window by building a 63-byte local copy of its name/path (this+0xB8, falling back to byte_5EA438 when null) and comparing it against three tokens, storing a numeric window type 0/1/2 in this+0xE4. Returns the outcome of the final comparison.

local_names.v2: window name/path pointer (this+0xB8) or default byte_5EA438

operations.description: Initialize local 63-byte buffer v4: first byte from default path byte_5EA438, remaining 60 bytes zeroed by memset.
v2 = window name/path pointer at this+0xB8; when v2 is null, substitute default path byte_5EA438.
sub_587DD0 copies at most 63 bytes from v2 into local buffer v4.
If sub_588410(v4, byte_5CC21C) returns zero, write window type 0 to this+0xE4.
If sub_588410(v4, aC_0) returns zero, write window type 1 to this+0xE4.
result = sub_588410(v4, aR); if result is zero, write window type 2 to this+0xE4.
Return result, the outcome of the final sub_588410(v4, aR) comparison.
